name: Cursor
paste_label: Paste this into Cursor's Agent chat

register.p: Then register it in ~/.cursor/mcp.json (Windows: %USERPROFILE%\.cursor\mcp.json). Merge this into the file, keeping every server already there. Create the file if it doesn't exist. If a {{SERVER}} entry already exists, ask the user before replacing it.

confirm.p: Ask the user to open Cursor Settings → MCP (or Tools & Integrations) and check {{SERVER}} shows as enabled with its tools. Reload the window if it doesn't appear.
